import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int[] tree;
    static int mod;
    static int size;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        mod = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int phiValue = totient(mod);
        int maxLength = n + 5;
        int[] factList = new int[maxLength + 1];
        factList[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= maxLength; i++) {
            factList[i] = (int)((long)factList[i - 1] * i % mod);
        }

        if (n <= 3) {
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }

        int[] dpArray = new int[2000];
        dpArray[0] = 1;
        dpArray[1] = 2;
        dpArray[2] = 2;
        dpArray[3] = 1;

        createTree(2005);
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            updateValue(i, dpArray[i]);
        }

        int m = 3;
        long answer = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < n - 3; i++) {
            int[] prevDp = Arrays.copyOf(dpArray, dpArray.length);
            long sumPartial = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j <= i + 2; j++) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= m + 1; k++) {
                    long sumRangeVal = sumRange(j + k + 1, 2004);
                    sumPartial += (sumRangeVal * prevDp[k - 1]) % mod;
                    sumPartial %= mod;
                    int idx = j + k;
                    dpArray[idx] = (dpArray[idx] + prevDp[k - 1]) % mod;
                    updateValue(idx, dpArray[idx]);
                }
            }
            m += i + 3;
            long productVal = productMod(i + 4, n, factList);
            answer += (productVal * sumPartial) % mod;
            answer %= mod;
        }
        System.out.println(answer);
    }

    static void createTree(int sizeInput) {
        size = 2;
        while (size < sizeInput) {
            size *= 2;
        }
        tree = new int[size];
        Arrays.fill(tree, 0);
    }

    static void updateValue(int i, int val) {
        int idx = i + size / 2;
        tree[idx] = val;
        idx /= 2;
        while (idx > 0) {
            tree[idx] = tree[2 * idx] + tree[2 * idx + 1];
            idx /= 2;
        }
    }

    static long sumRange(int s, int t) {
        s += size / 2;
        t += size / 2;
        long total = 0;
        while (s <= t) {
            if (s % 2 == 0) {
                s /= 2;
            } else {
                total += tree[s];
                s = (s + 1) / 2;
            }
            if (t % 2 == 1) {
                total += tree[t];
                t = (t - 1) / 2;
            } else {
                t /= 2;
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    static List<Integer> primeDecompose(int n) {
        List<Integer> factors = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 2; i * i <= n; i++) {
            while (n % i == 0) {
                factors.add(i);
                n /= i;
            }
            if (n == 1) {
                break;
            }
        }
        if (n != 1) {
            factors.add(n);
        }
        return factors;
    }

    static int totient(int n) {
        Set<Integer> pFactors = new HashSet<>(primeDecompose(n));
        int result = n;
        for (int p : pFactors) {
            result = result * (p - 1) / p;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static long productMod(int a, int b, int[] factList) {
        long res = 1;
        for (int i = a; i <= b; i++) {
            res = (res * i) % mod;
        }
        return res;
    }
